quote_or_summary: Cau hinh doi soat establishes school groups, branch relations, periods, service unit prices, and thresholds for active students.
BR01-BR10 defines immutable group codes, settlement units, email recipients maximum 3, schedule periods, fee thresholds, and rounded days.
SM2 captures a snapshot locking the pricing configuration from SM1 at session creation time, ensuring subsequent SM1 edits do not alter created sessions.
BR04 confirms service and tariff configurations are snapshotted into sessions at creation time and displayed in the locked config tab.
BR03 and MSG-01 mandate blocking session creation when any branch in the batch has a calculated fee of 0 VND.
Modal screenshot displays amber alert Khong the tao phien co tong phi 0d and disables the Tao phien button.
BR06 details session lifecycle: Nhap -> Cho duyet -> Da duyet / Da tu choi -> Da gui truong -> Da thanh toan, with Huy phien available in Nhap.
BR07 specifies that only Da thanh toan sessions enable Tao phien truy thu to generate nested child settlement sessions.
BR02 specifies that if settlement unit is Theo tung truong, each selected branch creates a distinct reconciliation session.
Screenshot shows top banner with Eco Card Portal logo, navigation items, Le Thuan user profile, and Doi soat active tab.
Slide-out drawer uses numbered badges (1, 2, 3, 4) for legal entity, settlement unit, schedule, and threshold sections.
Step modal enforces 1 Chon nhom truong, 2 Chon ky doi soat, 3 Xem truoc so lieu before session creation.
Detail screen organizes data into master metadata card, 4 KPI metric cards, tabs Chi tiet phi and Cau hinh da khoa, and right-aligned action buttons.
Architecture isolates SM1 configuration governance from SM2 session calculation and execution engine.
Data contracts establish relations between legal entity groups, schools, service periods, and tariffs.
UI conventions specify state-dependent action button visibility for draft, approved, and final states.
Non-functional requirements specify Vietnamese UI language, VND currency formatting with thousand separator, and DD/MM/YYYY dates.
